I added `textRendering='geometricPrecision'` to try to keep the dot, but it made no visible difference at 1080p. It is harmless, and one line in `drawHUD` undoes it. Fixing the glyph for real needs a font or size decision.
- **Couch-size type (v34.28):**
  - The belt key digits and counts and the minimap "n" are now 16 px on screen (were about 13 to 15).
